_readme: Demo applicant for the agent's saved-details autofill.
One invented person, chosen so that the three forms most worth demonstrating —
PAN (Form 49A), an income certificate, and a caste certificate — are all
plausible applications for her, and so that she is also the product's actual
target user: a dyslexic student who is entitled to exam accommodations under
the RPwD Act and whose family has probably never claimed them.
EVERY GOVERNMENT ID AND BANK FIELD IS DELIBERATELY ABSENT. That is the shipped
design, not an omission: a plausible-looking Aadhaar or account number is
indistinguishable from a real one once it is sitting in a government portal's
input, and a form submitted with a made-up ID is a worse outcome than a form
that was never filled. seed-profile.js --with-placeholders will add
format-invalid stand-ins if you want fuller screenshots; they cannot pass a
real portal's validation.
Nothing here belongs to a real person. The mobile numbers are synthetic
(9000000000 / 9000000001), the email is on the reserved example.com domain,
and the addresses are composed rather than copied.

profile.accommodations: Extra time in written examinations; question papers read aloud; a scribe or dictation permitted for long answers

_readme: Applied only with --with-placeholders. Every value here is INVALID BY
CONSTRUCTION so it cannot be accepted by a real portal even by accident:
aadhaar   Real Aadhaar numbers never begin with 0 or 1 and carry a
Verhoeff checksum. All zeroes fails both tests.
pan       Character 4 encodes holder type and character 5 must be the
surname initial. 'ZZZZZ0000Z' satisfies neither.
bankAccount / ifsc  IFSC must be a registered bank code; 'DEMO0000000'
is not allocated to any bank.
These exist for screenshots. Do not submit a form filled with them.
